turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I fear no man, Sandip. But I am not blind to the realities of our situation. The unrest among the Muslims is a real threat, and I will not hesitate to protect my people and my land from any who seek to harm them.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: Your fears are your own, Nikhil. But they do not diminish my resolve. The people look to me for leadership, not to you for your timidity. Let them see your weakness, and they will turn to me.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: Your resolve is misplaced, Sandip. If you continue to oppress and intimidate, you will only alienate the very people you seek to lead. And I warn you again, leave my people alone.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: Ah, Nikhil, your warnings fall on deaf ears. The people are with me, and they will see through your cowardice. But do not mistake my passion for yours; I will not be silenced by threats.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: Your arrogance will be your undoing, Sandip. Mark my words, the people will see through your false bravado.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: Nikhil, your doubts are as shallow as they are misplaced. The people see me as their champion, not as a weakling who hides behind threats. Let the chips fall where they may.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: Your arrogance blinds you, Sandip. The day will come when the people will question your true intentions. Until then, stay away from my land and my people.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: Nikhil, your fears are as petty as they are futile. The people's hearts beat with mine, and no idle threats will change that. Let the future judge our true mettle.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: Your stubbornness is your greatest weakness, Sandip. The people may follow you now, but their loyalty is not unshakeable. I advise you to think twice before pushing too far.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: Nikhil, your counsel is as predictable as it is unconvincing. The people will see the truth in my words and actions, not the shadows of your doubts.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I have given you more than enough leeway, Sandip. Your actions speak louder than your hollow words. I will not tolerate any further interference in my affairs.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: Nikhil, your warnings fall on deaf ears. The people’s hearts are mine to command, and your threats are but a faint whisper against the roar of my voice.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: Your arrogance blinds you, Sandip. But mark my words, the day will come when the people will question the very foundations of your power.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: The day you speak of will be the day the sun refuses to rise, my dear Nikhil. Your tenants are not puppets to be strung up and down at your whim.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: Your influence may sway the masses, Sandip, but it does not change the facts. My tenants are my responsibility, and I will not let you jeopardize their well-being.

turns.speaker: Bimala
turns.text: I... I am torn, Sandip, Nikhil. Your words are like two currents pulling me in different directions.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: And what choice would you have, my dear Bimala? The river of history flows deep and strong, carrying us all along its course. One must either ride the wave or be swept away by it.

turns.speaker: Bimala
turns.text: Your words are powerful, Sandip, but Nikhil speaks of duty and responsibility. I am caught between the tide of change and the anchor of loyalty.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: Bimala, I understand your dilemma, but you must see that Sandip's actions are reckless. He promises change but delivers instability and hardship for our people.

turns.speaker: Bimala
turns.text: I see the truth in both your words, Nikhil. Yet, Sandip's vision of a new future is compelling. How can I choose without betraying one for the other?

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: I say, Nikhil, don't you keep Browning among your books here? I was just telling Queen Bee of our college club. Do you remember that contest of ours over the translation of those lines from Browning? You don't?

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: I managed to get together the words to render it into Bengali, somehow, but the result was hardly likely to be a 'joy forever' to the people of Bengal. I really did think at one time that I was on the verge of becoming a poet, but Providence was kind enough to save me from that disaster. Do you remember old Dakshina? If he had not become a Salt Inspector, he would have been a poet. I remember his rendering to this day ... No, Queen Bee, it is no use rummaging those bookshelves. Nikhil has ceased to read poetry since his marriage--perhaps he has no further need for it. But I suppose 'the fever fit of poesy', as the Sanskrit has it, is about to attack me again.

opening.speaker: Nikhil
opening.text: I have come to give you a warning, Sandip

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: About the fever fit of poesy?

opening.speaker: Nikhil
opening.text: For some time, Mahomedan preachers have been about stirring up the local Mussulmans. They are all wild with you, and may attack you any moment.

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: Are you come to advise flight?

opening.speaker: Nikhil
opening.text: I have come to give you information, not to offer advice.

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: Had these estates been mine, such a warning would have been necessary for the preachers, not for me. If, instead of trying to frighten me, you give them a taste of your intimidation, that would be worthier both of you and me. Do you know that your weakness is weakening your neighbouring zamindars also?

opening.speaker: Nikhil
opening.text: I did not offer you my advice, Sandip. I wish you, too, would refrain from giving me yours. Besides, it is useless. And there is another thing I want to tell you. You and your followers have been secretly worrying and oppressing my tenantry. I cannot allow that any longer. So I must ask you to leave my territory.

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: For fear of the Mussulmans, or is there any other fear you have to threaten me with?
